overview_description.description: Zeqi is an AI-powered Ecommerce Operating System built to help small and medium-sized businesses plan, execute, and optimize their entire ecommerce operations. The platform integrates strategy, marketing automation, pricing intelligence, inventory optimization, creative analysis, and performance diagnostics into one unified system. Zeqi uses agentic AI workflows to identify opportunities, run actions across tools, and improve profitability without requiring large teams or technical expertise. Built for emerging markets and fast-growing ecommerce ecosystems, Zeqi gives founders a clear strategy, automated execution, and continuous growth insights.
